runtimeBinding: AUDIT_BASE_URL, AUDIT_ARTIFACT_ID and AUDIT_SOURCE_FINGERPRINT environment variables; never mutate source contract to bind a build

compatibility: native html props and forwarded button/anchor ref

invariants: Actual public Button identity, no markup replacement; fixture uses actual catalog demo and public native API
Every displayed enabled sample action has observable fictional local response
Click, Enter and Space activate exactly once where appropriate; loading and disabled block repeated activation
Busy and disabled states have accessible semantics and truthful cursor feedback; icon-only actions are named
No label or meaningful icon clipped, overlapped, lost or outside true constrained parent; long content remains accessible
Enabled ordinary text contrast >=4.5:1, required nontext and focus >=3:1 against actual resolved backgrounds
Primary coarse-pointer target >=44px; other targets >=24px or objectively documented spacing exception
Default density geometry documented separately from retained ku-button wrapper; no silent API reinterpretation
State transitions preserve same focused DOM control, draft input, callback counts and native ref
Reduced motion removes nonessential movement without disabling loading meaning or interactions
Zero unexplained console/resource/React failures; settled geometry drift <=1 CSSpx and idle CLS <=0.1
Each required screenshot personally opened at full resolution with SHA and observation; fresh independent capture required
coverageBlockers: Exact released-browser and platform qualification not established; Playwright engines cannot imply Safari/iOS
Physical touch and native screenreader unavailable unless actual platform supplied
Exhaustive API cross-products not yet enumerated; no acceptance permitted with remaining reachable variation gaps

fixtureValidation.nativeEnums: Declared type, size, shape, variant, color, iconPlacement, htmlType and labels are exact-whitelisted; duplicate values rejected
fixtureValidation.booleanQueries: Only true/false accepted; duplicate values rejected
fixtureValidation.delayMilliseconds: Finite value 0..60000; empty, negative, infinite and duplicate values rejected
